import React from "react"; function CoApplicantsSection({ section, coApplicants, onCoApplicantChange, onAddCoApplicant, onRemoveCoApplicant, }) { const maxCoApplicants = section.maxCoApplicants || 5; const canAddCoApplicant = coApplicants.length < maxCoApplicants; return (
{/* Header */}

{section.title}

Add co-applicant details. Maximum {maxCoApplicants} co-applicants allowed.

{/* Co-Applicants */}
{coApplicants.map((applicant, index) => (
{/* Header */}

Co-Applicant {index + 1}

{coApplicants.length > 1 && ( )}
{/* Fields */}
{/* Name */}
onCoApplicantChange( index, "name", event.target.value ) } />
{/* Phone */}
onCoApplicantChange( index, "phone", event.target.value ) } />
{/* Email */}
onCoApplicantChange( index, "email", event.target.value ) } />
{/* PAN */}
onCoApplicantChange( index, "pan", event.target.value.toUpperCase() ) } />
{/* Relation */}
onCoApplicantChange( index, "relation", event.target.value ) } />
))}
{/* Maximum message */} {!canAddCoApplicant && (

Maximum {maxCoApplicants} co-applicants reached.

)}
); } export default CoApplicantsSection;
